We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We need the molecule structure. We have no SMILES given. We can retrieve NMR spectra? The sample at hand maybe unknown. Could use carbon NMR to infer number of methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). But we need the molecule. Perhaps we can request proton NMR? But we need SMILES to get NMR. Not given.

Maybe there is a default sample? Could be from previous tasks. We might need to retrieve carbon shifts ranges? Not helpful.

Probably need to request carbon NMR spectra for the sample. Then count peaks in methyl region (10-30 ppm). But carbon NMR may have overlapping.

Better: Use HSQC to correlate protons to carbons, identify CH3 signals (proton ~0.9 ppm, carbon ~10-30 ppm). Count distinct CH3 signals.

Thus we need to call hsqc_nmr_spectra.
